captions.detailed: A wall-mounted, rectangular air purifier with a clean, flat, light-gray finish. It features a main outer casing, a front access door, and a rectangular filter cartridge hidden inside. The front door rotates outwards on a vertical hinge located on the left edge, while the filter cartridge slides horizontally out from the bottom guide rails behind the door.
captions.instruction: Create a wall-mounted air purifier with a main flat housing, an opening front door, and an internal filter cartridge. The front door should rotate on a vertical hinge along its left edge, and the filter cartridge should slide prismatically out of the bottom of the housing.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a hollowed-out box primitive to serve as the housing. Create the front door as a thin flat box, and position its hinge joint at the left edge using a revolute articulation. Model the filter cartridge as a smaller rectangular box inside the housing, and define its movement along the bottom guide rails using a prismatic articulation.
